An '''unknown male''' was the [[Parent|father]] of the feared [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. Sing herself always said that if she found her father, she would [[Death/Legends|kill]] him, and also that she did not know what his [[Aurra Sing's father's species|species]] was.<ref name="LOTF">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>

People who Aurra Sing had worked for have speculated that her father's species had been [[Qiraash/Legends|Qiraash]], [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]], [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]], or even [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]], despite the fact that none of these could interbreed with [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="CNII">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
